comments.value: I got confirmation from my friend that I can still enter the world early in the daytime, but at peak hours, the initialization time is increasing. It still seems unstable. I would like to continue testing and listening.
I spended from 21-23 pm, the initialization time is about 2 minutes.
I keep checking to see if it has been fixed. I was able to safely sleep in the instance today. I spent some time with a friend and it appears that I will not be kicked out.
There are much fewer stories of people getting kicked out of EAC, but there are still problems with slow initialization and timeouts. I am still monitoring the Japanese community.

It seems that some stability is being seen, but some people are still a bit slower than others. We will continue to track.
It is especially slow when entering the instance, especially after startup.
It is possible that some authentication is failing.

Progress on resolving this has been made, of which should be visible in app (changes came into effect 2 weeks ago). Further work is ongoing to ensure it stays low during peak hours (notably weekends) and to ensure that it is stable
Can you please temporarily disable the Japan region until the problem is resolved?

Well, 2022 is almost over and this problem is still not resolved? It doesn't seem to have improved since it has been in tracking. There have been a lot of bugs lately with the social screen lagging and not being able to update.

@{622303ad13e8f032580529a0|full_name}: We have spent a good deal of time trying to resolve this issue fully but unfortunately have not gotten it to a state where we are satisfied, things have been improved to a point where the JP region load times are normal (compared to other regions) with it being slower only sometimes during peak hours for the region.

Additionally in the last few weeks we have made various changes to ensure things are in the best place possible before the holidays, if all goes well the issue should basically not be noticeable at all. We will be continuing to monitor things over the holidays and at the start of next year return to work on this issue.

@{5ba749f34dca6b351d658330|full_name}: Sorry for the late response. I have a bit more information at this point and can hopefully shed some light on the issue. The source of the issue is, to my understanding, upstream of us, which makes any full solution very difficult. Currently, we are essentially manually applying first-aid every time an issue occurs, and on a cycle to try to be preventative. However, every now and then the issue reoccurs and we have to manually patch it again. 

That said, do keep letting us know when issues occur, so we can address them, and we are doing our best to get the upstream issue resolved as soon as possible.

details:
As the title says, when I set up an instance in JapanRegion, the world loading time swells up to several times longer than the previous version.(Slowly, more than a minute)
Since the open beta, there has been talk about slow loading, but there was no adequate verification, so the bug seems to have passed with the remaining bugs.
This can be avoided for now by using US or EU mackerels, but the lag problem will make it difficult to play the game world comfortably. This is a very big problem in the Asian region.
